import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 0:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((0, 1), (1, 0)):
                a, b = r - dr, c - dc
                while 0 <= a < h and 0 <= b < w and grid[a][b] == 0:
                    a -= dr; b -= dc
                x, y = r + dr, c + dc
                while 0 <= x < h and 0 <= y < w and grid[x][y] == 0:
                    x += dr; y += dc
                if (0 <= a < h and 0 <= b < w and 0 <= x < h and 0 <= y < w
                        and grid[a][b] != 0 and grid[a][b] == grid[x][y]):
                    out[r][c] = 2
                    break
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(source)
print(p)
